title: Daily standup
shortDescription: Give a short work update: what you did, what's next, and any blockers.
grammarTargets: Going to / will for next steps
conversationMoves: Ask what the learner worked on yesterday
Ask whether anything is blocking them
Follow up naturally on specifics they mention instead of moving through a checklist
Keep the tone brisk and professional, like a real standup
warmUpPrompts: Tell me one thing you finished yesterday.
What's the first thing you're tackling today?
rolePlayPrompts: Give a full standup update covering yesterday, today, and blockers.
Explain a blocker and ask a teammate for help.
challengePrompts: Explain a technical blocker to a non-technical stakeholder in plain language.
Push back politely when asked to take on more work mid-sprint.
successCriteria: Update covers yesterday, today, and blockers without prompting
Blockers are stated clearly enough that a teammate could help
Learner uses appropriate tense for completed vs ongoing work

suggestedReviewItems.content: Present continuous for describing ongoing work ('I'm working on...')

focusPlaceholder: e.g. talking about a specific project or blocker
